panels.title: Idle time piling up, per run
panels.about: Every gap over two minutes, added up as the run went
queries: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, sum(idle) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) AS value FROM ( SELECT e.at AS at, e.run AS run, r.name AS name, CASE WHEN e.at - lag(e.at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run ORDER BY e.at) > 120 THEN e.at - lag(e.at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run ORDER BY e.at) ELSE 0 END AS idle FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND e.run IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY 1) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
panels.label: Idle time per run

panels.title: Request time against timeouts.request
panels.about: One wait for the model is one point. By agent or by phase: the spread of those waits as a candle - the fastest to the slowest, the middle half, the average. Over time: every point, when it happened.
queries: SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, json_extract(payload,'$.seconds') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'request_end' ORDER BY at

SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.request' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.request' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
panels.label: Request time

panels.title: Requests that died, per minute
panels.about: A request that came back as an error rather than an answer, by agent
queries: SELECT CAST(at/60 AS INTEGER)*60 AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'request_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.ok') = 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
panels.label: Failed requests per minute

panels.title: Requests that died, in full
panels.about: What the error was, whose request it was, and how long it had been waiting
queries: SELECT at AS at, run, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'') AS phase, ROUND(json_extract(payload,'$.seconds'),1) AS seconds, json_extract(payload,'$.error') AS error FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'request_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.ok') = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
panels.label: Failed requests

panels.title: Cost
panels.about: What the run is costing, as a share: by the phase that spent it or by the agent that did. The same spend, two questions.
queries: SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, json_extract(payload,'$.usd') AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' AND at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY at

SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.usd_per_run' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.usd_per_run' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
panels.label: Cost

panels.title: Turns
panels.about: Tool calls in the window, by the phase that made them or by the agent.
queries: SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, 1 AS value FROM events WHERE kind = 'turn' AND at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY at
panels.label: Turns

panels.title: Time in a phase, minute by minute
panels.about: When each phase began and ended. A bar that reaches the right edge is still open.
queries: SELECT time, metric, value FROM (SELECT e.at AS time, coalesce(nullif(e.phase,''),'?') AS metric, coalesce(lead(e.at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run, e.phase ORDER BY e.at), r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) AS value, e.kind AS kind FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind IN ('phase_start','phase_end') AND ifnull(e.phase,'') <> '') WHERE kind = 'phase_start' AND value*1000 >= $__from AND time*1000 <= $__to ORDER BY time
panels.label: Phase timeline

panels.title: What one turn carried, against limits.turn_tokens
panels.about: Every turn as it was sent: the system prompt, what was inlined into it, and the conversation so far. A line per agent or per phase, climbing as the conversation grows.
queries: SELECT at*1000 AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, json_extract(payload,'$.context') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'turn' AND coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.context'),0) > 0 ORDER BY at

SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.turn_tokens' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.turn_tokens' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
panels.label: Context per turn

panels.title: Output per turn, by agent
panels.about: What the model actually wrote in one turn, as a spread: over time, by agent, or by phase. Read beside Context per turn: three hundred tokens read for every one written is a prompt problem.
queries: SELECT at*1000 AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'turn' AND coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out'),0) > 0 ORDER BY at
panels.label: Output per turn

panels.title: Silence between turns, against timeouts.turn
panels.about: The gap from one turn to the next, per agent. By agent or by phase: the spread of the gaps as a candle. Over time: every gap, when it happened. The longest are listed under Longest gaps.
queries: SELECT time, agent, phase, value FROM (SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run, coalesce(agent,'') ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'turn') WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY time

SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.turn' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'timeouts.turn' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
panels.label: Silence between turns

panels.title: Time in a session, minute by minute
panels.about: When each agent's session began and ended, one row per agent.
queries: SELECT time, metric, value FROM (SELECT e.at AS time, coalesce(nullif(e.agent,''),'?') AS metric, coalesce(lead(e.at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run, e.agent ORDER BY e.at), r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) AS value, e.kind AS kind FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind IN ('session_start','session_end') AND ifnull(e.agent,'') <> '') WHERE kind = 'session_start' AND value*1000 >= $__from AND time*1000 <= $__to ORDER BY time
panels.label: Session timeline

panels.title: Tokens out, per run
panels.about: Generated tokens as they accrued
queries: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS time, (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) AS metric, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out')) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT r.name FROM runs r WHERE r.run = events.run) ORDER BY at) AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' ORDER BY at) WHERE time*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
panels.label: Tokens out per run

panels.title: Tokens out
panels.about: Generated tokens as they accrued, stacked by the phase that generated them or by the agent.
queries: SELECT at AS time, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'no phase') AS phase, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'?') AS agent, json_extract(payload,'$.tokens_out') AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' AND at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY at
panels.label: Tokens out

panels.title: Cache, read against written
panels.about: Context read back from the cache against context written into it, as they accrued. Read climbing with written flat is a prompt paid for once; written climbing alongside is a prompt that will not settle.
queries: SELECT at AS time, 'read' AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.cache_read') AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' AND at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to UNION ALL SELECT at AS time, 'written' AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.cache_write') AS value FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND kind = 'spend' AND at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY 1
panels.label: Cache: read vs written

panels.title: Tokens and what they cost
panels.about: Every run in the window: what it generated, what it read back, and the bill
queries: SELECT r.started AS started, r.name AS run, coalesce(r.verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.tokens_out')) AS INTEGER) AS tokens_out, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cache_read')) AS INTEGER) AS cache_read, CAST(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.cache_write')) AS INTEGER) AS cache_write, ROUND(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.usd')), 2) AS usd FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run WHERE e.kind = 'spend' AND e.run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) GROUP BY e.run ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50
panels.label: Tokens and cost

panels.title: Memory against limits.memory_mb
panels.about: Read from outside every sample.every seconds: by container, or the same readings added up and labelled with the phase or the agent session that was open when they were taken.
queries: SELECT s.at AS time, json_extract(s.payload,'$.container') AS container, coalesce((SELECT p.phase FROM events p WHERE p.kind = 'phase_start' AND ifnull(p.phase,'') <> '' AND p.at <= s.at ORDER BY p.at DESC LIMIT 1),'no phase') AS phase, coalesce((SELECT a.agent FROM events a WHERE a.kind = 'session_start' AND ifnull(a.agent,'') <> '' AND a.at <= s.at ORDER BY a.at DESC LIMIT 1),'nobody') AS agent, json_extract(s.payload,'$.memory_mb') AS value FROM events s WHERE s.at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND s.kind = 'sample' ORDER BY s.at

SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.memory_mb' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at
panels.label: Memory

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.about: Docker's own figure, as cores: its percent of one core summed over every core, divided by a hundred. Ten cores busy is 10. Docker Desktop overshoots the machine's core count now and then; that is its sampling, not a container.
queries: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.cpu_pct')/100.0 AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Processes by container
panels.about: A count that climbs and never falls is something not being reaped
queries: SELECT at AS time, json_extract(payload,'$.container') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.pids') AS value FROM events WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND kind = 'sample' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Phases and branches
panels.about: One row per run, a bar per phase, in the order the runs started.
queries: SELECT time, metric, value, label FROM (SELECT e.at AS time, '#' || n.seq || ' ' || coalesce(r.name,'') AS metric, coalesce(lead(e.at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run, e.phase ORDER BY e.at), r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) AS value, coalesce(nullif(e.phase,''),'?') AS label, e.kind AS kind FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run = e.run JOIN (SELECT run, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY started) AS seq FROM runs) n ON n.run = e.run WHERE e.kind IN ('phase_start','phase_end') AND ifnull(e.phase,'') <> '') WHERE kind = 'phase_start' AND value*1000 >= $__from AND time*1000 <= $__to ORDER BY time
panels.label: Phases by run

panels.title: Gates: rounds, findings, minutes
panels.about: One row per gate: how many rounds it ran, how much it refused in all, and how many minutes the rounds and their repairs took. A gate that never finds anything is a tollbooth; one whose findings do not fall between rounds is asking for something the repair cannot give.
queries: SELECT max(at) AS time, 'rounds' AS metric, count(*) AS value, phase AS label FROM gates WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY phase UNION ALL SELECT max(at), 'findings', sum(findings), phase FROM gates WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY phase UNION ALL SELECT max(at), 'minutes', round(sum(seconds)/60.0, 1), phase FROM gates WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY phase ORDER BY 1
panels.label: Gates

panels.title: Busy and idle, per run
panels.about: Elapsed against the part of it where nothing happened for more than two minutes
queries: SELECT r.started AS started, r.finished AS finished, r.name AS run, coalesce(r.verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_min, CAST(((coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started) - coalesce(g.idle,0))/60 AS INTEGER) AS busy_min, CAST(coalesce(g.idle,0)/60 AS INTEGER) AS idle_min, ROUND(100.0*coalesce(g.idle,0) / max(1.0, coalesce(r.finished, strftime('%s','now')) - r.started), 1) AS idle_pct, ROUND(coalesce(r.usd,0),2) AS usd FROM runs r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT run, sum(gap) AS idle FROM ( SELECT run, CASE WHEN at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) > 120 THEN at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) ELSE 0 END AS gap FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND run IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY run) g ON g.run = r.run ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50
panels.label: Busy vs idle

panels.title: The longest gaps
panels.about: Every stretch over five minutes where nothing was reported, newest first
queries: SELECT * FROM (SELECT at AS at, run, coalesce(nullif(phase,''),'') AS phase, coalesce(nullif(agent,''),'') AS agent, CAST(gap/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes FROM (SELECT at, run, phase, agent, at - lag(at) OVER (PARTITION BY run ORDER BY at) AS gap FROM events WHERE run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM runs WHERE started*1000 > $__to OR (finished IS NOT NULL AND finished*1000 < $__from)) AND run IS NOT NULL) WHERE gap > 300 ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 50) WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
panels.label: Longest gaps

panels.title: What ammit did
panels.about: Every limit crossed, what it did about it, and what the command said back
queries: SELECT at AS at, scope, coalesce(subject,'') AS subject, rule, threshold, observed, action, coalesce(outcome,'') AS outcome FROM judgements ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
panels.label: Judgements

panels.title: Runs
queries: SELECT started AS started, finished AS finished, name, coalesce(verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(finished, strftime('%s','now')) - started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes, ROUND(coalesce(usd,0),2) AS usd, coalesce(turns,0) AS turns, coalesce(summary,'') AS summary FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Limits, as they stand
panels.about: What every chart above is drawn against, and when it last changed
queries: SELECT name, value, at AS changed FROM limits WHERE id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM limits GROUP BY name) ORDER BY name
panels.label: Current limits

panels.title: The same call, again
panels.about: One row per distinct call that ran more than once in the window
queries: SELECT agent, branch, kind, count(*) AS times, signature FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY agent, branch, signature HAVING times > 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 60
panels.label: Repeated calls

panels.title: The same file, however it was reached
panels.about: Grouped by what was touched rather than how it was touched
queries: SELECT agent, branch, target, group_concat(DISTINCT kind) AS kinds, count(*) AS times, count(DISTINCT signature) AS ways FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND ifnull(target,'') <> '' GROUP BY agent, branch, target HAVING times > 1 ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 60
panels.label: Repeated file touches

panels.title: What each phase spent its calls on
panels.about: Every call of the window by kind
queries: SELECT phase, kind, count(*) AS times FROM calls WHERE at*1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY phase, kind ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 80
panels.label: Calls by phase
